== Historical card identities and deck-table verification (Story 386) ==
The [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-retro-world-championship-ls-jeremy-christoffel-echo-base-operations/ published Retro decklist] and [[Media:26RWC Christoffel LS Echo Base Operations.txt|wiki-hosted XML download]] each contain 59 cards. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114010152/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2026-retro-world-championship-ls-jeremy-christoffel-echo-base-operations.html Players Committee decklist].
The article retains those quantities and the original download bytes (SHA-256 <code>ef2f89b4e254fb5e1a10db53c11864606555eca954dce269926a1f6a6f440af6</code>). The original forum ZIP has not been independently byte-verified.

Every linked card family was compared with the XML blueprint code. Existing Decipher printed articles were retained for the [[Premiere - Death Star II]] format; an unqualified XML code was not used to substitute a Modern Players Committee erratum. All 48 deck rows have card-image hovers bound to the same linked historical article. Card-type blocks and their contents are alphabetical, with whole blocks balanced between the columns.

Both published sources total 59; the article does not invent a sixtieth card. This is a discrepancy in the available decklist record, not evidence that the player actually used an illegal 59-card deck.
